      have ineq3: "(real M * \<bar>sin tt\<bar>)^2 \<le> (tt * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
        using power_mono[OF ineq2 nn] .
      have sq_ineq: "real M^2 * (sin tt)^2 \<le> tt^2 * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
      proof -
        have l: "(real M * \<bar>sin tt\<bar>)^2 = real M^2 * (sin tt)^2" by (simp add: power_mult_distrib)
        have r: "(tt * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2 = tt^2 * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
          by (simp add: power_mult_distrib)
        show ?thesis using ineq3 l r by linarith
      qed
      have tr: "4 * (1 - u)^3 * tt^2 \<le> pi^2 * w * (sin tt)^2"
        using core_trig[OF u(1) u(2) w(1) w(2) T0 Tw] .

        using K1 K2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)

        using K Kp by (intro le_of_mul_le_mul_right[of _ _ "tt^2"]) (simp_all add: algebra_simps)

        by (simp add: field_simps pnz wpos.ne')

      show ?thesis
        using K' by (simp only: fin) (subst pos_divide_le_eq[OF hpos]; simp add: algebra_simps)
    qed

steps.message: My build was killed, and the other forks' builds are still running. I'll rewrite `peak_sum` with explicit `subst`/`blast` steps instead of `auto`. I'll also add the remaining lemmas (`peak_qft`, `peak_prob`, and `shor_peak`) and build the whole file once.

arguments.command:
cd /tmp/w_peak && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/tmp/w_peak/Peak_test.thy'
s=open(p).read()
start=s.index("lemma peak_sum:")
end_=s.index("lemma peak_psi:")
new_sum=r'''lemma peak_sum:
  fixes N r x0 M :: nat and g :: "nat \<Rightarrow> complex"
  assumes set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
  shows "(\<Sum>k<N. if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then g k else 0) = (\<Sum>m<M. g (x0 + r * m))"
proof -
  let ?F = "(\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
  have mem2: "\<And>k. (k < N \<and> k mod r = x0) = (k \<in> ?F)"
  proof -
    fix k
    have "k \<in> {i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (k \<in> ?F)" by (subst set_eq) (rule refl)
    then show "(k < N \<and> k mod r = x0) = (k \<in> ?F)" by (simp add: mem_Collect_eq)
  qed
  have sub: "?F \<subseteq> {..<N}"
  proof
    fix k assume kF: "k \<in> ?F"
    have "k < N \<and> k mod r = x0" using mem2[of k] kF by blast
    then show "k \<in> {..<N}" by simp
  qed
  have "(\<Sum>k<N. if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then g k else 0) = (\<Sum>k\<in>?F. g k)"
  proof (rule sum.mono_neutral_cong_right)
    show "finite {..<N}" by simp
  next
    show "?F \<subseteq> {..<N}" by (rule sub)
  next
    fix k assume kd: "k \<in> {..<N} - ?F"
    then have kn: "k \<notin> ?F" by simp
    have notP: "\<not> (k < N \<and> k mod r = x0)" using mem2[of k] kn by blast
    show "(if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then g k else 0) = 0" using notP by auto
  next
    fix k assume kF: "k \<in> ?F"
    have P: "k < N \<and> k mod r = x0" using mem2[of k] kF by blast
    show "(if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then g k else 0) = g k" using P by auto
  qed
  also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>m<M. g (x0 + r * m))"
    by (subst sum.reindex[OF inj]) (simp add: comp_def)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

'''
s=s[:start]+new_sum+s[end_:]
s=s.rstrip()
if s.endswith("end"):
    s=s[:-3].rstrip()+"\n"
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
tail -5 Peak_test.thy; grep -c "" Peak_test.thy

steps.message: Now I'll append the amplitude lemma, the probability lemma, and `shor_peak` itself.

arguments.command:
cd /tmp/w_peak && cat >> Peak_test.thy <<'EOF'

lemma peak_qft:
  fixes N r x0 M j :: nat and c :: int and a :: real
  assumes set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
    and hN: "0 < N"
    and ha: "a = pi * real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N) / real N"
  shows "qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j =
    complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) *
      (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))"
proof -
  have psi: "periodic_state N r x0 = (\<lambda>k. if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) else 0)"
    by (rule peak_psi[OF set_eq inj])
  have hN' : "real N \<noteq> 0" using hN by simp
  have step1: "(\<Sum>k<N. cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N) * periodic_state N r x0 k)
      = (\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))"
  proof -
    have "(\<Sum>k<N. cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N) * periodic_state N r x0 k)
        = (\<Sum>k<N. if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N) else 0)"
      unfolding psi by (intro sum.cong) (simp_all add: mult.commute)
    also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))"
      by (rule peak_sum[OF set_eq inj])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have arg: "\<And>m. 2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N
      = (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) + 2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m)"
  proof -
    fix m
    show "2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N
      = (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) + 2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m)"
      unfolding ha using hN' by (simp add: field_simps) (simp add: algebra_simps)
  qed
  have cis_eq: "\<And>m. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)
      = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)"
  proof -
    fix m
    have z: "cis (2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m)) = 1"
      by (rule cis_multiple_2pi) (rule Ints_of_int)
    have "cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)
        = cis ((2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) + 2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m))"
      using arg[of m] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) * cis (2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m))"
      by (rule cis_mult[symmetric])
    also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m)"
      using z by simp
    also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)"
      by (rule cis_mult[symmetric])
    finally show "cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)
        = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)" .
  qed
  have step2: "(\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))
      = complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m))"
  proof -
    have "(\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))
        = (\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * (cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)))"
      by (intro sum.cong) (simp only: cis_eq)
    also have "\<dots> = complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * (cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))"
      by (simp only: sum_distrib_left mult.assoc)
    also have "\<dots> = complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m))"
      by (simp only: mult.assoc)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis
    unfolding qft_def
    by (simp only: step1 step2)
qed

lemma peak_prob:
  fixes N r x0 M j :: nat and c :: int and a :: real
  assumes set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
    and hN: "0 < N" and hM: "0 < M"
    and ha: "a = pi * real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N) / real N"
  shows "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2 / (real M * real N)"
proof -
  have hq: "qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j =
    complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) *
      (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))"
    by (rule peak_qft[OF set_eq inj hN ha])
  have sM: "sqrt (real M) ^ 2 = real M" by simp
  have sN: "sqrt (real N) ^ 2 = real N" by simp
  have "cmod (qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j) = (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) / sqrt (real N)"
    unfolding hq by (simp add: norm_divide norm_mult)
  then show ?thesis
    unfolding prob_def
    by (simp add: power_divide power_mult_distrib sM sN)
qed

theorem shor_peak:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
proof -
  obtain M where set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
    and spec: "N \<le> x0 + r * M" and top: "r * M < N + r"
    using peak_set[OF r x0 rN] by blast
  have hN: "0 < N" using rN r by simp
  have M_pos: "0 < M"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> 0 < M"
    then have "M = 0" by simp
    with spec have "N \<le> x0" by simp
    with x0 rN show False by linarith
  qed
  have state: "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0)"
    by (rule peak_state[OF set_eq inj M_pos])
  define a where "a = pi * real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N) / real N"
  have prob_eq: "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2 / (real M * real N)"
    by (rule peak_prob[OF set_eq inj hN M_pos]) (simp add: a_def)
  define D where "D = real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N)"
  have rN_real: "real r < real N" using rN by simp
  have x0_real: "real x0 < real r" using x0 by simp
  have hN_real: "(0::real) < real N" using hN by simp
  have hM_real: "(0::real) < real M" using M_pos by simp
  have hr_real: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have spec_r: "real N \<le> real x0 + real r * real M"
    using spec by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_le_iff of_nat_mult)
  have top_r: "real r * real M < real N + real r"
    using top by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_less_iff of_nat_mult)
  have u0: "0 \<le> real r / real N" by simp
  have u1: "real r / real N < 1" using rN_real hN_real by (simp add: divide_less_eq_1)
  have w1: "1 - real r / real N \<le> real M * real r / real N"
  proof -
    have "real N - real r \<le> real M * real r" using spec_r x0_real by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
    then have "(real N - real r) / real N \<le> (real M * real r) / real N"
      by (rule divide_right_mono) (simp add: hN_real.le)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: diff_divide_distrib)
  qed
  have w2: "real M * real r / real N \<le> 1 + real r / real N"
  proof -
    have "real M * real r \<le> real N + real r" using top_r by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
    then have "(real M * real r) / real N \<le> (real N + real r) / real N"
      by (rule divide_right_mono) (simp add: hN_real.le)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: add_divide_distrib)
  qed
  have near_r: "2 * \<bar>D\<bar> \<le> real r"
  proof -
    have "real_of_int (2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar>) \<le> real_of_int (int r)"
      using near by (subst of_int_le_iff) simp
    then show ?thesis unfolding D_def by simp
  qed
  have hT: "real M * \<bar>a\<bar> \<le> pi * (real M * real r / real N) / 2"
  proof -
    have absa: "\<bar>a\<bar> = pi * \<bar>D\<bar> / real N"
      unfolding a_def D_def by (simp add: abs_divide abs_mult)
    have "real M * \<bar>a\<bar> = (pi * real M / real N) * \<bar>D\<bar>"
      using absa by (simp add: field_simps)
    also have "\<dots> \<le> (pi * real M / real N) * (real r / 2)"
      by (rule mult_left_mono) (use near_r in linarith, simp add: hN_real.le hM_real.le)
    also have "\<dots> = pi * (real M * real r / real N) / 2"
      by (simp add: field_simps)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have core: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (1 - real r / real N)^3 / (real M * real r / real N) * (real M)\<^sup>2
      \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2"

lemma peak_qft:
  fixes N r x0 M j :: nat and c :: int and a :: real
  assumes set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
    and hN: "0 < N"
    and ha: "a = pi * real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N) / real N"
  shows "qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j =
    complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) *
      (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))"
proof -
  have psi: "periodic_state N r x0 = (\<lambda>k. if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) else 0)"
    by (rule peak_psi[OF set_eq inj])
  have hN' : "real N \<noteq> 0" using hN by simp
  have step1: "(\<Sum>k<N. cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N) * periodic_state N r x0 k)
      = (\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))"
  proof -
    have "(\<Sum>k<N. cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N) * periodic_state N r x0 k)
        = (\<Sum>k<N. if k < N \<and> k mod r = x0 then complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real k / real N) else 0)"
      unfolding psi by (intro sum.cong) (simp_all add: mult.commute)
    also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))"
      by (rule peak_sum[OF set_eq inj])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have arg: "\<And>m. 2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N
      = (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) + 2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m)"
  proof -
    fix m
    show "2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N
      = (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) + 2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m)"
      unfolding ha using hN' by (simp add: field_simps) (simp add: algebra_simps)
  qed
  have cis_eq: "\<And>m. cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)
      = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)"
  proof -
    fix m
    have z: "cis (2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m)) = 1"
      by (rule cis_multiple_2pi) (rule Ints_of_int)
    have "cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)
        = cis ((2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) + 2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m))"
      using arg[of m] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m) * cis (2 * pi * real_of_int (c * int m))"
      by (rule cis_mult[symmetric])
    also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N + 2 * a * real m)"
      using z by simp
    also have "\<dots> = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)"
      by (rule cis_mult[symmetric])
    finally show "cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N)
        = cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)" .
  qed
  have step2: "(\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))
      = complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m))"
  proof -
    have "(\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real (x0 + r * m) / real N))
        = (\<Sum>m<M. complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * (cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * cis (2 * a * real m)))"
      by (intro sum.cong) (simp only: cis_eq)
    also have "\<dots> = complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * (cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))"
      by (simp only: sum_distrib_left mult.assoc)
    also have "\<dots> = complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) * (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m))"
      by (simp only: mult.assoc)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis
    unfolding qft_def
    by (simp only: step1 step2)
qed

lemma peak_prob:
  fixes N r x0 M j :: nat and c :: int and a :: real
  assumes set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
    and hN: "0 < N" and hM: "0 < M"
    and ha: "a = pi * real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N) / real N"
  shows "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2 / (real M * real N)"
proof -
  have hq: "qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j =
    complex_of_real (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cis (2 * pi * real j * real x0 / real N) *
      (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) / complex_of_real (sqrt (real N))"
    by (rule peak_qft[OF set_eq inj hN ha])
  have sM: "sqrt (real M) ^ 2 = real M" by simp
  have sN: "sqrt (real N) ^ 2 = real N" by simp
  have "cmod (qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j) = (1 / sqrt (real M)) * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) / sqrt (real N)"
    unfolding hq by (simp add: norm_divide norm_mult)
  then show ?thesis
    unfolding prob_def
    by (simp add: power_divide power_mult_distrib sM sN)
qed

theorem shor_peak:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
proof -
  obtain M where set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
    and spec: "N \<le> x0 + r * M" and top: "r * M < N + r"
    using peak_set[OF r x0 rN] by blast
  have hN: "0 < N" using rN r by simp
  have M_pos: "0 < M"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> 0 < M"
    then have "M = 0" by simp
    with spec have "N \<le> x0" by simp
    with x0 rN show False by linarith
  qed
  have state: "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0)"
    by (rule peak_state[OF set_eq inj M_pos])
  define a where "a = pi * real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N) / real N"
  have prob_eq: "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2 / (real M * real N)"
    by (rule peak_prob[OF set_eq inj hN M_pos]) (simp add: a_def)
  define D where "D = real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N)"
  have rN_real: "real r < real N" using rN by simp
  have x0_real: "real x0 < real r" using x0 by simp
  have hN_real: "(0::real) < real N" using hN by simp
  have hM_real: "(0::real) < real M" using M_pos by simp
  have hr_real: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have spec_r: "real N \<le> real x0 + real r * real M"
    using spec by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_le_iff of_nat_mult)
  have top_r: "real r * real M < real N + real r"
    using top by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_less_iff of_nat_mult)
  have u0: "0 \<le> real r / real N" by simp
  have u1: "real r / real N < 1" using rN_real hN_real by (simp add: divide_less_eq_1)
  have w1: "1 - real r / real N \<le> real M * real r / real N"
  proof -
    have "real N - real r \<le> real M * real r" using spec_r x0_real by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
    then have "(real N - real r) / real N \<le> (real M * real r) / real N"
      by (rule divide_right_mono) (simp add: hN_real.le)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: diff_divide_distrib)
  qed
  have w2: "real M * real r / real N \<le> 1 + real r / real N"
  proof -
    have "real M * real r \<le> real N + real r" using top_r by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
    then have "(real M * real r) / real N \<le> (real N + real r) / real N"
      by (rule divide_right_mono) (simp add: hN_real.le)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: add_divide_distrib)
  qed
  have near_r: "2 * \<bar>D\<bar> \<le> real r"
  proof -
    have "real_of_int (2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar>) \<le> real_of_int (int r)"
      using near by (subst of_int_le_iff) simp
    then show ?thesis unfolding D_def by simp
  qed
  have hT: "real M * \<bar>a\<bar> \<le> pi * (real M * real r / real N) / 2"
  proof -
    have absa: "\<bar>a\<bar> = pi * \<bar>D\<bar> / real N"
      unfolding a_def D_def by (simp add: abs_divide abs_mult)
    have "real M * \<bar>a\<bar> = (pi * real M / real N) * \<bar>D\<bar>"
      using absa by (simp add: field_simps)
    also have "\<dots> \<le> (pi * real M / real N) * (real r / 2)"
      by (rule mult_left_mono) (use near_r in linarith, simp add: hN_real.le hM_real.le)
    also have "\<dots> = pi * (real M * real r / real N) / 2"
      by (simp add: field_simps)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have core: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (1 - real r / real N)^3 / (real M * real r / real N) * (real M)\<^sup>2
      \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2"
    by (rule core_sum_lower[OF u0 u1 w1 w2 hT])
  have key: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (1 - real r / real N)^3 / (real M * real r / real N) * (real M)\<^sup>2
      = 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 * (real M * real N)"
    using hN_real hM_real hr_real by (simp add: field_simps)
  have ineq: "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2 / (real M * real N)"
  proof -
    have pos: "0 < real M * real N" using hM_real hN_real by simp
    show ?thesis
      by (subst pos_le_divide_eq[OF pos]) (use core key in simp)
  qed
  show ?thesis using state ineq prob_eq by simp
qed

- `sum.mono_neutral_cong_right` takes its zero-premise as a `∀` formula, so the `fix/assume` bullet doesn't refine that goal.
- The extra `simp` after `unfolding` in `arg` runs on a closed goal.

I'll patch those and rewrite the body of `shor_peak` with simpler closing steps.

s=s[:i]+r'''theorem shor_peak:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rN: "r < N" and x0: "x0 < r" and j: "j < N"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) \<and>
    4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
proof -
  obtain M where set_eq: "{i. i < N \<and> i mod r = x0} = (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) ` {..<M}"
    and inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>m. x0 + r * m) {..<M}"
    and spec: "N \<le> x0 + r * M" and top: "r * M < N + r"
    using peak_set[OF r x0 rN] by blast
  have hN: "0 < N" using rN r by simp
  have M_pos: "0 < M"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> 0 < M"
    then have "M = 0" by simp
    with spec have "N \<le> x0" by simp
    with x0 rN show False by linarith
  qed
  have state: "is_state N (periodic_state N r x0)"
    by (rule peak_state[OF set_eq inj M_pos])
  define a where a_def: "a = pi * real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N) / real N"
  have prob_eq: "prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2 / (real M * real N)"
    by (rule peak_prob[OF set_eq inj hN M_pos a_def])
  define D where D_def: "D = real_of_int (int j * int r - c * int N)"
  have rN_real: "real r < real N" using rN by simp
  have x0_real: "real x0 < real r" using x0 by simp
  have hN_real: "(0::real) < real N" using hN by simp
  have hM_real: "(0::real) < real M" using M_pos by simp
  have hr_real: "(0::real) < real r" using r by simp
  have spec_r: "real N \<le> real x0 + real r * real M"
    using spec by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_le_iff of_nat_mult)
  have top_r: "real r * real M < real N + real r"
    using top by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_less_iff of_nat_mult)
  have u0: "0 \<le> real r / real N" by simp
  have u1: "real r / real N < 1" using rN_real hN_real by (simp add: divide_less_eq_1)
  have w1: "1 - real r / real N \<le> real M * real r / real N"
  proof -
    have "real N - real r \<le> real M * real r" using spec_r x0_real by linarith
    then have "(real N - real r) / real N \<le> (real M * real r) / real N"
      by (rule divide_right_mono) (simp add: hN_real.le)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: diff_divide_distrib)
  qed
  have w2: "real M * real r / real N \<le> 1 + real r / real N"
  proof -
    have "real M * real r \<le> real N + real r" using top_r by linarith
    then have "(real M * real r) / real N \<le> (real N + real r) / real N"
      by (rule divide_right_mono) (simp add: hN_real.le)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: add_divide_distrib)
  qed
  have near_r: "2 * \<bar>D\<bar> \<le> real r"
  proof -
    have "real_of_int (2 * \<bar>int j * int r - c * int N\<bar>) \<le> real_of_int (int r)"
      using near by (subst of_int_le_iff) simp
    then show ?thesis unfolding D_def by simp
  qed
  have pmn: "0 \<le> pi * real M / real N"
    using pi_gt_zero by (intro divide_nonneg_nonneg mult_nonneg_nonneg) auto
  have hT: "real M * \<bar>a\<bar> \<le> pi * (real M * real r / real N) / 2"
  proof -
    have absa: "\<bar>a\<bar> = pi * \<bar>D\<bar> / real N"
      unfolding a_def D_def by (simp add: abs_divide abs_mult pi_gt_zero)
    have "real M * \<bar>a\<bar> = (pi * real M / real N) * \<bar>D\<bar>"
      using absa by (simp add: field_simps)
    also have "\<dots> \<le> (pi * real M / real N) * (real r / 2)"
    proof (rule mult_left_mono)
      show "\<bar>D\<bar> \<le> real r / 2" using near_r by linarith
    next
      show "0 \<le> pi * real M / real N" using pmn .
    qed
    also have "\<dots> = pi * (real M * real r / real N) / 2"
      by (simp add: field_simps)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have core: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (1 - real r / real N)^3 / (real M * real r / real N) * (real M)\<^sup>2
      \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2"
    by (rule core_sum_lower[OF u0 u1 w1 w2 hT])
  have key: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (1 - real r / real N)^3 / (real M * real r / real N) * (real M)\<^sup>2
      = 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 * (real M * real N)"
    using hN_real hM_real hr_real pi_gt_zero by (simp add: field_simps) (try ring)
  have pos: "0 < real M * real N" using hM_real hN_real by simp
  have ineq: "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2 / (real M * real N)"
    by (subst pos_le_divide_eq[OF pos]) (linarith)
  have fin: "4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N)^3 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
    using ineq prob_eq by simp
  show ?thesis using state fin by blast
qed

end

theory Core
  imports Complex_Main
begin

lemma core_pi_bounds: "2 \<le> pi" "pi < 4"
proof -
  have "sin (pi / 2) \<le> pi / 2" using sin_x_le_x[of "pi / 2"] by simp
  then show "2 \<le> pi" "pi < 4" using pi_less_4 by simp_all
qed

lemma core_jordan:
  assumes t0: "0 \<le> t" and t1: "t \<le> pi / 2"
  shows "2 * t / pi \<le> sin t"
proof -
  have pi_pos: "0 < pi" using core_pi_bounds by simp
  have hy0: "0 \<le> 2 / pi" using pi_pos by simp
  have hy1: "2 / pi \<le> 1" using core_pi_bounds pi_pos by (simp add: pos_divide_le_eq)
  have hlo: "-1 \<le> 2 / pi" using hy0 by linarith
  have s0: "0 \<le> arccos (2 / pi)" using arccos_bounded[OF hlo hy1] by blast
  have sp: "arccos (2 / pi) \<le> pi / 2" using arccos_le_pi2[OF hy0 hy1] .
  have cs: "cos (arccos (2 / pi)) = 2 / pi" using cos_arccos[OF hlo hy1] .
  have ex: "\<exists>s. 0 \<le> s \<and> s \<le> pi / 2 \<and> cos s = 2 / pi"
    using s0 sp cs by blast
  from ex obtain s where s0': "0 \<le> s" and sp': "s \<le> pi / 2" and cs': "cos s = 2 / pi"
    by blast
  have fpi: "(\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) (pi / 2) = 0"
  proof -
    have "2 * (pi / 2) / pi = 1" using pi_pos by (simp add: field_simps)
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "t \<le> s")
    case True
    have hd: "\<And>x. 0 \<le> x \<Longrightarrow> x \<le> t \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) x :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y"
    proof -
      fix x assume h1: "0 \<le> x" and h2: "x \<le> t"
      have "cos s \<le> cos x"
        using cos_monotone_0_pi_le[of x s] h1 h2 True sp' core_pi_bounds by linarith
      have der: "DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) x :> (cos x - 2 / pi)"
        by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: field_simps)
      show "\<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) x :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y"
        using der cs' `cos s \<le> cos x` by (intro exI[of _ "cos x - 2 / pi"]) linarith
    qed
    have "(\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) 0 \<le> (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) t"
      using DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing[OF t0 hd] .
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then have ts: "s \<le> t" by simp
    have hd: "\<And>x. t \<le> x \<Longrightarrow> x \<le> pi / 2 \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0"
    proof -
      fix x assume h1: "t \<le> x" and h2: "x \<le> pi / 2"
      have "cos x \<le> cos s"
        using cos_monotone_0_pi_le[of s x] ts h1 h2 s0' core_pi_bounds by linarith
      have der: "DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) x :> (cos x - 2 / pi)"
        by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: field_simps)
      show "\<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0"
        using der cs' `cos x \<le> cos s` by (intro exI[of _ "cos x - 2 / pi"]) linarith
    qed
    have "(\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) t \<ge> (\<lambda>x. sin x - 2 * x / pi) (pi / 2)"
      using DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing[OF t1 hd] .
    then show ?thesis using fpi by simp
  qed
qed

lemma core_trig:
  assumes u0: "0 \<le> u" and u1: "u < 1" and w1: "1 - u \<le> w" and w2: "w \<le> 1 + u"
    and T0: "0 < T" and Tw: "T \<le> pi * w / 2"
  shows "4 * (1 - u)^3 * T^2 \<le> pi^2 * w * (sin T)^2"
proof -
  have pb: "2 \<le> pi" "pi < 4" using core_pi_bounds by auto
  have pi_pos: "0 < pi" using pb by simp
  have pnz: "pi \<noteq> 0" using pi_pos by simp
  have v1: "0 < 1 - u" using u1 by linarith
  have wpos: "0 < w" using w1 v1 by linarith
  have w2': "w < 2" using w2 u0 u1 by linarith
  have hu2: "0 \<le> u * (2 - u)" using u0 u1 by (intro mult_nonneg_nonneg) linarith+
  have a1: "(1 - u)^2 \<le> 1" using hu2 by (simp add: power2_eq_square algebra_simps)
  have v2: "(1 - u)^3 \<le> w"
  proof -
    have "(1 - u) * (1 - u)^2 \<le> (1 - u) * 1" using mult_left_mono[OF a1 (less_imp_le[OF v1])] .
    then have "(1 - u)^3 \<le> (1 - u)" by (simp add: power3_eq_cube power2_eq_square algebra_simps)
    then show ?thesis using w1 by linarith
  qed
  have pw0: "0 \<le> pi^2 * w" using wpos by simp
  have v0: "0 \<le> (1 - u)^3" using v1 by simp
  consider (le) "T \<le> pi / 2" | (gt) "pi / 2 < T" by linarith
  then show ?thesis
  proof cases
    case le
    have j: "2 * T / pi \<le> sin T" using core_jordan[OF (less_imp_le[OF T0]) le] .
    have hnn: "0 \<le> 2 * T / pi" using T0 pi_pos by (intro divide_nonneg_nonneg) linarith+
    have sq: "(2 * T / pi)^2 \<le> (sin T)^2" using power_mono[OF j hnn] .
    have eq: "pi^2 * (2 * T / pi)^2 = 4 * T^2" by (simp add: field_simps pnz)
    have A0: "pi^2 * (2 * T / pi)^2 \<le> pi^2 * (sin T)^2" using mult_left_mono[OF sq pw0 ] by simp
    have A: "4 * T^2 \<le> pi^2 * (sin T)^2" using eq A0 by linarith
    have B: "(1 - u)^3 * (4 * T^2) \<le> w * (4 * T^2)" using mult_right_mono[OF v2] by simp
    have C: "w * (4 * T^2) \<le> w * (pi^2 * (sin T)^2)" using mult_left_mono[OF A (less_imp_le[OF wpos])] by simp
    have E1: "4 * (1 - u)^3 * T^2 = (1 - u)^3 * (4 * T^2)" by algebra
    have E2: "pi^2 * w * (sin T)^2 = w * (pi^2 * (sin T)^2)" by algebra
    show ?thesis using B C E1 E2 by linarith
  next
    case gt
    have hTpi: "pi * w < pi * 2" using w2' pi_pos by simp
    have hTp: "T \<le> pi * w / 2" using Tw by simp
    have hpt0: "0 \<le> pi - T" using hTp hTpi by linarith
    have hpt1: "pi - T \<le> pi / 2" using gt by linarith
    have j2: "2 * (pi - T) / pi \<le> sin (pi - T)" using core_jordan[OF hpt0 hpt1] .
    have sinT: "sin (pi - T) = sin T" by simp
    have ed: "2 * (pi - T) / pi = 2 - 2 * T / pi" by (simp add: field_simps pnz)
    have hT2: "2 * T / pi \<le> w"
      by (rule pos_divide_le_eq[OF pi_pos, THEN iffD2]) (use Tw in linarith)
    have hs: "1 - u \<le> sin T" using j2 sinT ed hT2 w2 by linarith
    have hsq: "(1 - u)^2 \<le> (sin T)^2" using power_mono[OF hs (less_imp_le[OF v1])] .
    have T2a: "T^2 \<le> (pi * w / 2)^2" using power_mono[OF Tw (less_imp_le[OF T0])] .
    have T2: "4 * T^2 \<le> pi^2 * w^2" using T2a by (simp add: power_divide algebra_simps)
    have E0: "(1 - u) * w \<le> (1 - u) * (1 + u)" using mult_left_mono[OF w2 (less_imp_le[OF v1])] .
    have E1: "(1 - u) * w \<le> 1" using E0 sq_nonneg u by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
    have X: "(1 - u)^3 * (4 * T^2) \<le> (1 - u)^3 * (pi^2 * w^2)" using mult_left_mono[OF T2 v0] .
    have K0: "0 \<le> pi^2 * w * (1 - u)^2" using pw0 by simp
    have Y: "(pi^2 * w * (1 - u)^2) * ((1 - u) * w) \<le> (pi^2 * w * (1 - u)^2) * 1"
      using mult_left_mono[OF E1 K0] .
    have Z: "pi^2 * w * (1 - u)^2 \<le> pi^2 * w * (sin T)^2" using mult_left_mono[OF hsq pw0] .
    have E3: "4 * (1 - u)^3 * T^2 = (1 - u)^3 * (4 * T^2)" by algebra
    have E4: "(pi^2 * w * (1 - u)^2) * ((1 - u) * w) = (1 - u)^3 * (pi^2 * w^2)" by algebra
    show ?thesis using X Y Z E3 E4 by linarith
  qed

lemma core_cis_diff: "cmod (cis (2 * y) - 1) = 2 * \<bar>sin y\<bar>"
proof -
  have c2: "cos (2 * y) = 2 * cos y ^ 2 - 1" by (rule cos_double_cos)
  have s2: "sin (2 * y) = 2 * sin y * cos y" by (rule sin_double)
  have e: "cos y ^ 2 = 1 - sin y ^ 2" using sin_cos_squared_add[of y] by linarith
  have key: "(2 * cos y ^ 2 - 2)^2 + (2 * sin y * cos y)^2 = 4 * sin y ^ 2"
  proof -
    have k1: "(2 * sin y * cos y)^2 = 4 * sin y ^ 2 * cos y ^ 2" by algebra
    show ?thesis by (simp only: k1 e) algebra
  qed
  have sq: "(cmod (cis (2 * y) - 1))^2 = (2 * \<bar>sin y\<bar>)^2"
  proof -
    have "(cmod (cis (2 * y) - 1))^2 = (cos (2 * y) - 1)^2 + (sin (2 * y))^2"
      by (simp add: cmod_power2)
    also have "\<dots> = (2 * cos y ^ 2 - 2)^2 + (2 * sin y * cos y)^2"
      by (simp only: c2 s2) algebra
    also have "\<dots> = 4 * sin y ^ 2" using key .
    also have "\<dots> = (2 * \<bar>sin y\<bar>)^2" by (simp add: power_mult_distrib)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis
    using sq norm_ge_zero[of "cis (2 * y) - 1"] abs_ge_zero[of "sin y"]
    by (intro power2_eq_imp_eq) (use sq in simp_all)
qed

lemma core_norm_S:
  "\<bar>sin a\<bar> * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) = \<bar>sin (real M * a)\<bar>"
proof -
  have h1: "cmod (cis (2 * a) - 1) = 2 * \<bar>sin a\<bar>" by (rule core_cis_diff)
  have h2: "cmod (cis (2 * a) ^ M - 1) = 2 * \<bar>sin (real M * a)\<bar>"
  proof -
    have "cis (2 * a) ^ M - 1 = cis (2 * (real M * a)) - 1"
      by (simp add: DeMoivre algebra_simps)
    then show ?thesis using core_cis_diff[of "real M * a"] by simp
  qed
  have gp: "(cis (2 * a) - 1) * (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a) ^ m) = cis (2 * a) ^ M - 1"
    by (induct M) (simp_all add: lessThan_Suc algebra_simps)
  have sumz: "(\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) = (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a) ^ m)"
    by (rule sum.cong[OF refl]) (simp add: DeMoivre algebra_simps)
  have eqn: "cmod (cis (2 * a) ^ M - 1) = cmod (cis (2 * a) - 1) * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a) ^ m)"
    by (subst gp[symmetric]) (simp add: norm_mult)
  have chain: "2 * \<bar>sin (real M * a)\<bar> = 2 * \<bar>sin a\<bar> * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a) ^ m)"
    using h1 h2 eqn by simp
  have goal: "\<bar>sin a\<bar> * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a) ^ m) = \<bar>sin (real M * a)\<bar>"
    using chain by linarith
  show ?thesis using goal sumz by simp
qed

lemma core_sum_lower:
  fixes M :: nat and a u w :: real
  assumes u: "0 \<le> u" "u < 1"
    and w: "1 - u \<le> w" "w \<le> 1 + u"
    and hT: "real M * \<bar>a\<bar> \<le> pi * w / 2"
  shows "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (1 - u)^3 / w * (real M)\<^sup>2 \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))\<^sup>2"
proof -
  have pb: "2 \<le> pi" "pi < 4" using core_pi_bounds by auto
  have pi_pos: "0 < pi" using pb by simp
  have pnz: "pi \<noteq> 0" using pi_pos by simp
  have pp: "0 < pi^2" using pi_pos by simp
  have v1: "0 < 1 - u" using u by linarith
  have wpos: "0 < w" using w v1 by linarith
  have w2': "w < 2" using w u by linarith
  have hu2: "0 \<le> u * (2 - u)" using u by (intro mult_nonneg_nonneg) linarith+
  have a1: "(1 - u)^2 \<le> 1" using hu2 by (simp add: power2_eq_square algebra_simps)
  have v2: "(1 - u)^3 \<le> w"
  proof -
    have "(1 - u) * (1 - u)^2 \<le> (1 - u) * 1" using mult_left_mono[OF a1 (less_imp_le[OF v1])] .
    then have "(1 - u)^3 \<le> (1 - u)" by (simp add: power3_eq_cube power2_eq_square algebra_simps)
    then show ?thesis using w by linarith
  qed
  have v0: "0 \<le> (1 - u)^3" using v1 by simp
  have ratio0: "0 \<le> (1 - u)^3 / w" using v0 wpos by (intro divide_nonneg_nonneg) linarith+
  have ratio1: "(1 - u)^3 / w \<le> 1"
    using v2 wpos by (simp add: pos_divide_le_eq)
  have c1: "4 / pi^2 \<le> 1" using pb pp by (simp add: pos_divide_le_eq)
  have c0: "0 \<le> 4 / pi^2" using pp by simp
  have fac: "4 / pi^2 * (1 - u)^3 / w = (4 / pi^2) * ((1 - u)^3 / w)"
    by (simp add: field_simps pnz wpos.ne')
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "a = 0")
    case True
    have Sn: "cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) = real M"
      by (simp add: True)
    have q: "4 / pi^2 * (1 - u)^3 / w \<le> 1"
      using fac mult_le_one[OF c1 ratio0 ratio1] by linarith
    have h: "4 / pi^2 * (1 - u)^3 / w * (real M)^2 \<le> 1 * (real M)^2"
      using mult_right_mono[OF q sq_nonneg[of "real M"]] .
    show ?thesis by (simp only: Sn) linarith
  next
    case False
    have aa: "0 < \<bar>a\<bar>" using False by simp
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "M = 0")
      case True
      show ?thesis by (simp add: True)
    next
      case False2: False
      have Mpos: "0 < real M" using False2 by simp
      obtain tt where Tdef: "tt = real M * \<bar>a\<bar>" by blast
      have T0: "0 < tt" using Tdef Mpos aa by (subst Tdef) (rule mult_pos[OF Mpos aa])
      have Tw: "tt \<le> pi * w / 2" using Tdef hT by simp
      have sinab: "\<bar>sin (real M * a)\<bar> = \<bar>sin tt\<bar>"
      proof (cases "0 \<le> a")
        case True
        have "tt = real M * a" using Tdef True by simp
        then show ?thesis by simp
      next
        case False3: False
        have "tt = - (real M * a)" using Tdef False3 by simp
        then show ?thesis by (simp add: sin_minus)
      qed
      have hsn: "\<bar>sin a\<bar> * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) = \<bar>sin (real M * a)\<bar>"
        by (rule core_norm_S)
      have hle: "\<bar>sin a\<bar> \<le> \<bar>a\<bar>" by (rule abs_sin_x_le_abs_x)
      have s0: "0 \<le> cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m))" by simp
      have ineq1: "\<bar>sin tt\<bar> \<le> \<bar>a\<bar> * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m))"
        using hsn sinab mult_right_mono[OF hle s0] by linarith
      have ineq2: "real M * \<bar>sin tt\<bar> \<le> tt * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m))"
      proof -
        have "real M * \<bar>sin tt\<bar> \<le> real M * (\<bar>a\<bar> * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))"
          using mult_left_mono[OF ineq1 (less_imp_le[OF Mpos])] .
        moreover have "tt * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)) = real M * (\<bar>a\<bar> * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))"
          using Tdef by (simp add: algebra_simps)
        ultimately show ?thesis by linarith
      qed
      have nn: "0 \<le> real M * \<bar>sin tt\<bar>" using Mpos by simp
      have ineq3: "(real M * \<bar>sin tt\<bar>)^2 \<le> (tt * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
        using power_mono[OF ineq2 nn] .
      have sq_ineq: "real M^2 * (sin tt)^2 \<le> tt^2 * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
      proof -
        have l: "(real M * \<bar>sin tt\<bar>)^2 = real M^2 * (sin tt)^2" by (simp add: power_mult_distrib)
        have r: "(tt * cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2 = tt^2 * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
          by (simp add: power_mult_distrib)
        show ?thesis using ineq3 l r by linarith
      qed
      have tr: "4 * (1 - u)^3 * tt^2 \<le> pi^2 * w * (sin tt)^2"
        using core_trig[OF u(1) u(2) w(1) w(2) T0 Tw] .
      have K1: "4 * (1 - u)^3 * tt^2 * real M^2 \<le> pi^2 * w * (sin tt)^2 * real M^2"
        using mult_right_mono[OF tr sq_nonneg] by simp
      have pw0: "0 \<le> pi^2 * w" using wpos by simp
      have K2: "pi^2 * w * (real M^2 * (sin tt)^2) \<le> pi^2 * w * (tt^2 * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2)"
        using mult_left_mono[OF sq_ineq pw0] .
      have K: "4 * (1 - u)^3 * real M^2 * tt^2 \<le> pi^2 * w * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2 * tt^2"
        using K1 K2 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
      have Kp: "0 < tt^2" using T0 by simp
      have K': "4 * (1 - u)^3 * real M^2 \<le> pi^2 * w * (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
        using K Kp by (intro le_of_mul_le_mul_right[of _ _ "tt^2"]) (simp_all add: algebra_simps)
      have fin: "4 / pi^2 * (1 - u)^3 / w * (real M)^2 = (4 * (1 - u)^3 * (real M)^2) / (pi^2 * w)"
        by (simp add: field_simps pnz wpos.ne')
      have hpos: "0 < pi^2 * w" using pp wpos by simp
      have lhs: "4 * (1 - u)^3 * (real M)^2 \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2 * (pi^2 * w)"
        using K' by linarith
      have fin2: "(4 * (1 - u)^3 * (real M)^2) / (pi^2 * w) \<le> (cmod (\<Sum>m<M. cis (2 * a * real m)))^2"
        using iffD2[OF pos_divide_le_eq[OF hpos] lhs] .
      show ?thesis by (subst fin) (rule fin2)
    qed
  qed
qed

end

  fixes c s :: real
  assumes pyth: "c^2 + s^2 = 1"
  shows "(2 * c^2 - 2)^2 + (2 * s * c)^2 = 4 * s^2"
  using pyth by algebra

lemma core_cis_diff: "cmod (cis (2 * y) - 1) = 2 * \\<bar>sin y\\<bar>"
proof -
  have c2: "cos (2 * y) = 2 * cos y ^ 2 - 1" by (rule cos_double_cos)
  have s2: "sin (2 * y) = 2 * sin y * cos y" by (rule sin_double)
  have pyth: "cos y ^ 2 + sin y ^ 2 = 1" using sin_cos_squared_add[of y] by linarith
  have sq: "(cmod (cis (2 * y) - 1))^2 = (2 * \\<bar>sin y\\<bar>)^2"
  proof -
    have "(cmod (cis (2 * y) - 1))^2 = (cos (2 * y) - 1)^2 + (sin (2 * y))^2"
      by (simp add: cmod_power2 cis_def)
    also have "\\<dots> = (2 * cos y ^ 2 - 2)^2 + (2 * sin y * cos y)^2"
      by (simp only: c2 s2) (simp add: algebra_simps)

    also have "\\<dots> = (2 * \\<bar>sin y\\<bar>)^2" by (simp add: power_mult_distrib)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis
    by (rule power2_eq_imp_eq[OF sq norm_ge_zero]) simp
qed

'''
